Libraries
```{r}

#for mefisto
library(reticulate)
reticulate::use_condaenv("mofa2_env", required = TRUE)
reticulate::py_config()
reticulate::py_module_available("mofapy2")



library(ggplot2)
library(svdx)
library(svdxBenchmark)
library(patchwork)
library(tidyverse)
library(Matrix)
library(Biobase)
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)
library(stringr)
```

```{r load-raw}

circ <- readRDS( "circadian_mouse_zhang_microarray.rds" ) 
pData(circ)$sample <- colnames(circ)
pData(circ)$tissue_type <- factor( pData(circ)$tissue_type )

fdata <- fData(circ)
Y_raw <- exprs(circ)
xdata <- pData(circ)
zdata <- xdata
```

# Define SVDX formulas
```{r formulas}
xformula <- ~ time
zformula <- ~ tissue_type
```

# Optional inputs
```{r optional-inputs}
row_offsets <- rep(0, nrow(circ))
col_offsets <- rep(0, ncol(circ))
t_j <- NULL

```

# Preprocess

For the non-family SVDX, we use `family = NULL`.

Because sparse row-centering densifies the matrix, either use dense input or set `center_rows = FALSE` for sparse input unless we intentionally allow densification.

```{r preprocess}
fdata <- as_svdx_fdata(
  fdata,
  feature_col = "id", #these are the rownames in the circ data
  label_col = "symbol", #these are what we will use for labeling features in plots
  enrichment_col = "symbol" #these are what we will use for enrichment when we do inferecne
)

prepared <- svdx:::prepare_svdx_data(
  Y = Y_raw,
  xdata = xdata,
  zdata = zdata,
  xformula = xformula,
  zformula = zformula,
  fdata = fdata,
  family = NULL, 
  log1p_transform = FALSE,              #already transformed      
  t_j = rep(0, ncol(Y_raw)),
  normalize = FALSE,                    #data has already been normalization
  top_ftrs = 5000,
  center_rows = TRUE,    
  scale_rows = TRUE,
  allow_sparse_densification = TRUE,
  col_offset = rep(0, ncol(Y_raw)),
  row_offset = rep(0, nrow(Y_raw)),
  dataset_name = "circadian"
)
```

#benchmark
```{r}
METHODS <- c(
  "svdx",
  "pca",
  "mefisto_duplicate_view",
  "nmf",
  "mixomics_pls",
  "spca",
  "sparse_nmf"
)
SPCA_KEEPX_GRID <- round(c(0.01, 0.25, 0.5) * nrow(prepared$Y))
SPARSE_NMF_LAMBDA_GRID <- 10^c(-3, -2, -1)
rw_single <- run_real_world_single_benchmark(
  
  Y = prepared$Y,
  data = prepared$xdata,
  xformula = prepared$xformula,
  zdata = prepared$zdata,
  zformula = prepared$zformula,
  fdata = fdata, 

  K = 15,
  
  
  methods = METHODS, 
  spca_keepX_grid = SPCA_KEEPX_GRID,
  sparse_nmf_lambda_grid = SPARSE_NMF_LAMBDA_GRID,
  mefisto_covariates = "time",
  
  inference_methods = c("svdx"), 
  
  ftol_abs = 1e-5, 
  
  run_factorization = TRUE,
  run_inference = TRUE,
  
  inference_scope = "all",
  feature_sets = NULL,
  enrichment_backend = "internal",
  msigdb_db_species = "MM", 
  msigdb_species = "Mus musculus", 
  msigdb_collection = "M5", 
  msigdb_subcollection = "BP"
)


```


#output
```{r}
rw <- runSingleBenchmarkReports( rw_single = rw_single, 
                                 outdir = "./circadian",
                                 overwrite=T, 
                                 color="tissue_type", group="tissue_type", 
                                 line_group = "tissue_type", 
                                 xaxis="time", 
                                 loading_enrichment = T,
                                 enrichment_top_n = 25
                                 )


```
